## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- What a burst tyre comes off as, with a [Tyre Wrench](Tyre-Wrench); fitted again, the tyre is still burst.
- The only wheel these 2 vehicle types take: Combine, Tractor.

## Crafting

No recipe makes or uses it.

## Scrap

Cannot be scrapped: a Scrap Machine destroys it, see [Scrap](Scrap).
